title: Consensus, validator, and historical producer presentation qualification
objective: Qualify the repository Explorer consensus/validator service and historical block-producer presentation path, including slot/epoch/rotation arithmetic, committee/proposer integrity, checkpoint/QC provenance, authority boundaries, HTTP serialization, and execution-to-consensus producer trace presentation.

owns: Explorer consensus service validation and derived presentation fields
Indexer-client canonical-authority rejection for consensus reads
historical block producer trace presentation and authority labeling
repository fail-closed handling for malformed consensus projections

defects_remediated: Explorer consensus presentation did not verify current/next-slot continuity
Explorer consensus presentation did not verify epoch and rotation arithmetic against NextSlot
Explorer consensus presentation did not verify SlotsPerRotation equals SlotsPerEpoch multiplied by EpochsPerRotation
Explorer consensus presentation did not require checkpoint roots or certified-QC block provenance
Explorer consensus presentation did not reject certified QCs beyond the projected head/current slot
Explorer consensus presentation did not independently enforce a minimum three-seat active committee
acceptance_criteria: AC-1 validator/producer Explorer resources expose representative indexed data correctly
AC-3 consensus/finality/proposer projections preserve internal provenance and ordering
AC-5 malformed, contradictory, unavailable, or authority-overclaiming consensus data fails closed
AC-6 repository service/API path is qualified while live target-network evidence remains explicitly deferred
AC-8 Explorer remains a non-authoritative projection consumer
qualification_tests: representative consensus status and derived participation/boundary values
current/next slot continuity and epoch/rotation arithmetic negatives
minimum active committee and proposer membership/collision negatives
HTTP /v1/consensus serialization/provenance headers and malformed projection failure

qualification_evidence.exact_head_policy: The evidence-recording commit must itself pass the exact-head EXP-2.4 and retained qualification suite before the milestone is marked COMPLETE.
